name: Structure Tools
description: Auto-builds level structure in the editor. Pillars down and up.

fill-block-id.name: Pillar Block ID
fill-block-id.description: Object ID that pillars are built from. Use the block variant with lines on the <cy>sides only</c> so the pillar looks continuous. Easiest way to set it: select ONE block in the editor and press <cg>Pick</c>. <cy>0</c> = fall back to the platform's own block (solid blocks only; slopes always need an ID).

max-rows.name: Max Pillar Height
max-rows.description: The most blocks one pillar can have.

ground-y.name: Ground Row Y
ground-y.description: Y position of the lowest block row sitting on the ground. In the normal editor this is <cy>105</c>. Downward pillars never go below this.

button-offset-x.name: Button Offset X
button-offset-x.description: Nudge the Down / Up / Pick buttons left (negative) or right (positive). Takes effect next time you open the editor.

button-offset-y.name: Button Offset Y
button-offset-y.description: Nudge the Down / Up / Pick buttons down (negative) or up (positive). Takes effect next time you open the editor.
